title: SpawnLar
description: Safe teleportation to spawn with countdown and cancellation system
body:
# SpawnLar

SpawnLar is a lightweight and efficient Bukkit/Spigot/Paper plugin that provides safe teleportation to the server spawn using a smart countdown system.

Players can use the `/hub` command to teleport to spawn with a delay. If the player moves, takes damage, or executes any command, the teleport is automatically cancelled to prevent abuse and ensure fair gameplay.

## Features
- /hub command with a 5-second countdown
- Teleport cancellation on movement, damage, or commands
- Automatic teleport on join (configurable)
- Fully customizable messages (messages.yml)
- Multi-world support
- Lightweight and optimized for performance

## How it works
When a player executes `/hub`, a countdown begins. If any movement, damage, or command is detected, the teleport is cancelled instantly. A short grace period prevents accidental cancellation right after running the command.

## Configuration
You can configure:
- Spawn location (`locations.yml`)
- Messages (`messages.yml`)
- Join behavior (`config.yml`)

## Compatibility
- Spigot / Paper / Purpur
- Minecraft 1.20+ / 1.21+

## Commands
- `/hub` — teleport to spawn
- `/spawnlar reload` — reload configuration

## Permissions
- `spawnlar.hub`
- `spawnlar.admin`
